lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Canada on the minds of American voters ahead of the U.S. midterm elections, CityNews Winnipeg reports.

National Transportation Safety Board member Tom Chapman said that evidence found at the crash site indicates the aircraft was breaking up before making impact impact on Sunday, The Associated Press reports.
